protocol: Kingman flying personnel and chamber crew. Initial chamber profile included a 20,000-ft demonstration and up to two hours at 38,000 ft. Following symptoms, subjects were brought down and returned to 38,000 ft for five minutes. Gas history and exact re-ascent rate unavailable. The reported interval starts when leaving 38,000 ft and ends on return to 38,000 ft, including descent and re-ascent.
note: Same-site recurrence in subjects selected on original bends. Exact numerator unavailable for this stratum.
